theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  simp only
  intro y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) (y := y)
  have hq (k : Fin 2) :
      (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate] at h
    exact (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
  have hd : (fiberMap 1).val - (fiberMap 0).val = 1 := by
    have h0 := congrArg Subtype.val
      (qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0)
    have h1 := congrArg Subtype.val
      (qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1)
    simp only [Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte,
      Submodule.coe_add, SetLike.val_smul, zero_smul, one_smul,
      get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, Submodule.coe_zero, zero_add] at h0 h1
    change (fiberMap 0).val = _ at h0
    change (fiberMap 1).val = _ at h1
    rw [h1, h0]
    ring
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have he (k : Fin 2) :
      (intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ coeffs).eval
        (fiberMap k).val = P₀.eval y.val + (fiberMap k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    rw [evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X,
      Polynomial.eval_comp, hq, P₀, P₁]
  change
    (intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ coeffs).eval
      (fiberMap 0).val * ((1 - r_chal) * (fiberMap 1).val - r_chal) +
    (intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ coeffs).eval
      (fiberMap 1).val * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * (fiberMap 0).val) = _
  rw [he 0, he 1]
  calc
    _ = (P₀.eval y.val * (1 - r_chal) + P₁.eval y.val * r_chal) *
        ((fiberMap 1).val - (fiberMap 0).val) := by ring
    _ = P₀.eval y.val * (1 - r_chal) + P₁.eval y.val * r_chal := by rw [hd, mul_one]
    _ = _ := by
      dsimp only [P₀, P₁, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly]
      simp only [Nat.sub_add_eq, Polynomial.eval_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]
      rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) (y := y)
  have hq (k : Fin 2) :
      (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate] at h
    exact (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
  have hd : (fiberMap 1).val - (fiberMap 0).val = 1 := by
    have hf (k : Fin 2) := congrArg Subtype.val
      (qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y k)
    rw [hf 1, hf 0]
    simp only [Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte,
      Submodule.coe_add, SetLike.val_smul, zero_smul, one_smul,
      Submodule.coe_zero, zero_add]
    rw [get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ (by omega)]
    exact add_sub_cancel_right _ _
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have he (k : Fin 2) :
      (intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ coeffs).eval
        (fiberMap k).val = P₀.eval y.val + (fiberMap k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    rw [evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X,
      Polynomial.eval_comp, hq, P₀, P₁]
  dsimp only [fold]
  rw [he 0, he 1]
  calc
    _ = (P₀.eval y.val * (1 - r_chal) + P₁.eval y.val * r_chal) *
        ((fiberMap 1).val - (fiberMap 0).val) := by ring
    _ = P₀.eval y.val * (1 - r_chal) + P₁.eval y.val * r_chal := by rw [hd, mul_one]
    _ = _ := by
      dsimp only [P₀, P₁, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly]
      simp only [Nat.sub_add_eq, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]
      rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      rw [add_mul]
      ac_rfl

    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs

      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by

    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) (y := y)
  have hq (k : Fin 2) :

    rw [hf 1, hf 0]
    simp only [Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte,

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) (y := y)
  have hq (k : Fin 2) :
      (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate] at h
    exact (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
  have hd : (fiberMap 1).val - (fiberMap 0).val = 1 := by
    have hf (k : Fin 2) := congrArg Subtype.val
      (qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y k)
    rw [hf 1, hf 0]
    simp only [Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte,
      Submodule.coe_add, SetLike.val_smul, zero_smul, one_smul,
      get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, Submodule.coe_zero, zero_add, add_sub_cancel_right]
  let a := (evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  let b := (oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  dsimp only [fiberMap] at hq
  simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_comp, hq]
  calc
    _ = (a * (1 - r_chal) + b * r_chal) *
        ((fiberMap 1).val - (fiberMap 0).val) := by ring
    _ = a * (1 - r_chal) + b * r_chal := by rw [hd, mul_one]
    _ = _ := by
      dsimp only [a, b, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly]
      simp only [Nat.sub_add_eq, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]
      rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) (y := y)
  have hq (k : Fin 2) :
      (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate] at h
    exact (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
  have hd : (fiberMap 1).val - (fiberMap 0).val = 1 := by
    have hf (k : Fin 2) := congrArg Subtype.val
      (qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y k)
    rw [hf 1, hf 0]
    simp only [Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte,
      Submodule.coe_add, SetLike.val_smul, zero_smul, one_smul,
      get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩
        (fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_R i), Submodule.coe_zero, zero_add, add_sub_cancel_right]
  let a := (evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  let b := (oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  dsimp only [fiberMap] at hq
  simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_comp, hq]
  calc
    _ = a * (1 - r_chal) + b * r_chal := by
      linear_combination (a * (1 - r_chal) + b * r_chal) * hd
    _ = _ := by
      dsimp only [a, b, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly]
      simp only [Nat.sub_add_eq, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
        Finset.sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) (y := y)
  have hq (k : Fin 2) :
      (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate] at h
    exact (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
  have hd : (fiberMap 1).val - (fiberMap 0).val = 1 := by
    simp only [fiberMap, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y,
      Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte,
      Submodule.coe_add, SetLike.val_smul, zero_smul, one_smul,
      get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, Submodule.coe_zero, zero_add, add_sub_cancel_right]
  let a := (evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  let b := (oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  dsimp only [fiberMap] at hq
  simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_comp, hq]
  calc
    _ = a * (1 - r_chal) + b * r_chal := by
      linear_combination (a * (1 - r_chal) + b * r_chal) * hd
    _ = _ := by
      dsimp only [a, b, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly]
      simp only [Nat.sub_add_eq, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
        Finset.sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) (y := y)
  have hq (k : Fin 2) := (congrArg Subtype.val
    ((generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).trans
      (iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega)
        (fiberMap k)))).symm
  have hd : (fiberMap 1).val - (fiberMap 0).val = 1 := by
    simp only [fiberMap, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y,
      Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte,
      Submodule.coe_add, SetLike.val_smul, zero_smul, one_smul,
      get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, Submodule.coe_zero, zero_add, add_sub_cancel_right]
  let a := (evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  let b := (oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  dsimp only [fiberMap] at hq
  simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_comp, hq]
  calc
    _ = a * (1 - r_chal) + b * r_chal := by
      linear_combination (a * (1 - r_chal) + b * r_chal) * hd
    _ = _ := by
      dsimp only [a, b, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly]
      simp only [Nat.sub_add_eq, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
        Finset.sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) (y := y)
  have hq (k : Fin 2) := (congrArg Subtype.val
    ((generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).trans
      (iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega)
        (fiberMap k)))).symm
  have hd : (fiberMap 1).val - (fiberMap 0).val = 1 := by
    simp [fiberMap, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y,
      Fin2ToF2, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  let a := (evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  let b := (oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  dsimp only [fiberMap] at hq
  simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_comp, hq]
  calc
    _ = a * (1 - r_chal) + b * r_chal := by
      rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp hd]
      ring
    _ = _ := by
      dsimp only [a, b, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly]
      simp only [Nat.sub_add_eq, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
        Finset.sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) (y := y)
  have hq (k : Fin 2) := (congrArg Subtype.val
    ((generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).trans
      (iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega)
        (fiberMap k)))).symm
  have hd : (fiberMap 1).val - (fiberMap 0).val = 1 := by
    have hf := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y
    rw [hf 1, hf 0]
    simp only [
      Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte,
      Submodule.coe_add, SetLike.val_smul, zero_smul, one_smul,
      get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, Submodule.coe_zero, zero_add, add_sub_cancel_right]
  let a := (evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  let b := (oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  dsimp only [fiberMap] at hq
  simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_comp, hq]
  calc
    _ = a * (1 - r_chal) + b * r_chal := by
      rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp hd]
      ring
    _ = _ := by
      dsimp only [a, b, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly]
      simp only [Nat.sub_add_eq, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
        Finset.sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) (y := y)
  have hq (k : Fin 2) := (congrArg Subtype.val
    ((generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).trans
      (iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega)
        (fiberMap k)))).symm
  have hd : (fiberMap 1).val - (fiberMap 0).val = 1 := by
    have hf := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y
    dsimp only [fiberMap]
    rw [hf 1, hf 0]
    simp only [
      Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte,
      Submodule.coe_add, SetLike.val_smul, zero_smul, one_smul,
      get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, Submodule.coe_zero, zero_add, add_sub_cancel_right]
  let a := (evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  let b := (oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  dsimp only [fiberMap] at hq
  simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_comp, hq]
  calc
    _ = a * (1 - r_chal) + b * r_chal := by
      rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp hd]
      ring
    _ = _ := by
      dsimp only [a, b, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly]
      simp only [Nat.sub_add_eq, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
        Finset.sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) (y := y)
  have hq (k : Fin 2) := (congrArg Subtype.val
    ((generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).trans
      (iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega)
        (fiberMap k)))).symm
  have hd : (fiberMap 1).val = 1 + (fiberMap 0).val := by
    simp only [fiberMap, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y,
      Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte,
      Submodule.coe_add, SetLike.val_smul, zero_smul, one_smul,
      get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, Submodule.coe_zero, zero_add]
  let a := (evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  let b := (oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  dsimp only [fiberMap] at hq
  simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_comp, hq]
  calc
    _ = a * (1 - r_chal) + b * r_chal := by
      rw [hd]
      ring
    _ = _ := by
      dsimp only [a, b, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly]
      simp only [Nat.sub_add_eq, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
        Finset.sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) (y := y)
  have hq (k : Fin 2) := (congrArg Subtype.val
    ((generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).trans
      (iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega)
        (fiberMap k)))).symm
  have hd : (fiberMap 1).val = 1 + (fiberMap 0).val := by
    simp only [fiberMap, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y,
      Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte,
      Submodule.coe_add, SetLike.val_smul, zero_smul, one_smul,
      get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, Submodule.coe_zero, zero_add]
  dsimp only [fiberMap] at hq
  simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_comp, hq]
  simp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly, Nat.sub_add_eq,
    Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
    Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  rw [hd]
  ring

  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) (y := y)
  have hq (k : Fin 2) := (congrArg Subtype.val
    ((generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).trans

        (fiberMap k)))).symm
  have hd : (fiberMap 1).val = 1 + (fiberMap 0).val := by
    simp only [fiberMap, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y,
      Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte,

      Submodule.coe_zero, zero_add]
  dsimp only [fiberMap] at hq

    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_comp, hq]
  dsimp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly]
  simp only [Nat.sub_add_eq,
    Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
    Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl

  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) (y := y)
  have hq (k : Fin 2) := (congrArg Subtype.val
    ((generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).trans
      (iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega)
        (fiberMap k)))).symm

    simp only [fiberMap, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y,
      Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte,
      Submodule.coe_add, zero_smul, one_smul,
      get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, zero_add]
  dsimp only [fiberMap] at hq
  simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_comp, hq]
  dsimp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly]
  simp only [Nat.sub_add_eq,
    Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
    Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) (y := y)
  have hq (k : Fin 2) := (congrArg Subtype.val
    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩)).symm
  simp only [fiberMap, iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at hq
  simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_comp, hq]
  simp only [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y,
    Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte,
    Submodule.coe_add, zero_smul, one_smul, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, zero_add]
  dsimp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly]
  simp only [Nat.sub_add_eq,
    Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
    Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  have hq (k : Fin 2) := (congrArg Subtype.val
    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩)).symm
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at hq
  simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_comp, hq]
  dsimp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly]
  simp only [Nat.sub_add_eq, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
    Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y,
    Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte,
    Submodule.coe_add, zero_smul, one_smul, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, zero_add]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  have hq (k : Fin 2) := (congrArg Subtype.val
    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩)).symm
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at hq
  simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_comp, hq]
  dsimp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly]
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
    Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y,
    Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte,
    Submodule.coe_add, zero_smul, one_smul, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, zero_add]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  ring

  ⟩) coeffs

      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>

        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  have hq (k : Fin 2) := (congrArg Subtype.val
    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
      _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩)).symm
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at hq
  simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_comp, hq]
  dsimp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly]
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
    Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
    Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte,
    Submodule.coe_add, zero_smul, one_smul, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, zero_add]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  ring1

  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)

    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by

    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt

  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at hq
  simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,

  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  have hq (k : Fin 2) := (congrArg Subtype.val
    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β
      (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) i 1 i.isLt
      _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩)).symm
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at hq
  simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_comp, hq]
  dsimp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly]
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
    Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) i i.isLt y,
    Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte,
    Submodule.coe_add, zero_smul, one_smul, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, zero_add]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  ring

    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  have hq (k : Fin 2) := (congrArg Subtype.val
    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
      _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩)).symm
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at hq
  simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_comp, hq]
  have hf (k : Fin 2) := congrArg Subtype.val
    (qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y k)
  dsimp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly]
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
    Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    hf,
    Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte,
    Submodule.coe_add, zero_smul, one_smul, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, zero_add]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  have hq (k : Fin 2) := (congrArg Subtype.val
    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
      _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩)).symm
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at hq
  simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_comp, hq]
  simp only [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
    Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte,
    Submodule.coe_add, zero_smul, one_smul, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, zero_add]
  dsimp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly]
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
    Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  have hq (k : Fin 2) := (congrArg Subtype.val
    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
      _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩)).symm
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at hq
  simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_comp, hq]
  dsimp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly]
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
    Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt,
    Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte,
    Submodule.coe_add, zero_smul, one_smul, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, zero_add]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  have hq (k : Fin 2) := (congrArg Subtype.val
    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
      _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩)).symm
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at hq
  simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_comp, hq]
  simp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
    Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
    Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
    Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte,
    Submodule.coe_add, zero_smul, one_smul, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, zero_add]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  ring1

  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  have hq (k : Fin 2) := (congrArg Subtype.val
    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
      _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩)).symm
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at hq
  simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_comp, hq]
  simp only [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
    Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte,
    Submodule.coe_add, zero_smul, one_smul, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, zero_add]
  dsimp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly]
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
    Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  have hq (k : Fin 2) := (congrArg Subtype.val
    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
      _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩)).symm
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at hq
  simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_comp, hq]
  dsimp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly]
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
    Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
    Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte,
    Submodule.coe_add, zero_smul, one_smul, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, zero_add]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  simp only [add_mul, sub_mul, mul_add, one_mul, mul_one, mul_assoc]
  abel

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  have hq (k : Fin 2) := (congrArg Subtype.val
    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
      _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩)).symm
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at hq
  simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_comp, hq]
  dsimp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly]
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
    Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
    Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte,
    Submodule.coe_add, zero_smul, one_smul, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, zero_add]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  ring1

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  have hq (k : Fin 2) := (congrArg Subtype.val
    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
      _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩)).symm
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at hq
  simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_comp, hq]
  simp only [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
    Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte,
    Submodule.coe_add, zero_smul, one_smul, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, zero_add]
  conv_lhs => ring_nf
  dsimp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly]
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
    Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  have hq (k : Fin 2) := (congrArg Subtype.val
    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
      _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩)).symm
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at hq
  simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_comp, hq]
  dsimp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly]
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
    Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
    Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte,
    Submodule.coe_add, zero_smul, one_smul, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, zero_add]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  ring1

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  have hq (k : Fin 2) := (congrArg Subtype.val
    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
      _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩)).symm
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at hq
  simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_comp, hq]
  dsimp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly]
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
    Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib,

    Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte,
    Submodule.coe_add, zero_smul, one_smul, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, zero_add]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
